nodes.title: 📋 Features & Requirements
widgets_values:
## Requirements

### Required
- [rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy)
- [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)
- [ComfyUI-GGUF](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF)
- [ComfyUI-DaSiWa-Nodes](https://github.com/darksidewalker/ComfyUI-DaSiWa-Nodes)
- [ffmpeg](https://www.ffmpeg.org/)

### Optional
- [SageAttention](https://github.com/thu-ml/SageAttention) — faster inference when installed

---

## Core Features

- 🎬 **All MiniMax H3 modes** - T2VA, I2VA, FLF2VA, REF2VA in one workflow
- 🖼️ **Reference Director** - drag-and-drop media, slot-based ordering, trims, per-media prompts
- 🎵 **Audio support** - embedded video audio (V/A/V+A switch), standalone audio tracks
- 🎯 **Smart resolution** - automatic aspect-ratio fitting and megapixel presets
- ⚡ **RTX upscaling** - optional real-time super-resolution (RTX GPUs)
- 💧 **Watermark overlay** - custom branding on final output
- 🚀 **Performance optimizations**
- 💾 **Advanced automatic video save**
- 🖼️ **First/last frame extraction**
- ➿ **Frame interpolation**


### Live Preview
- `ComfyUI-KJNodes` is required for the **Fast H3 Video Preview** node.
- Default mode uses fast Latent2RGB animation; the final video decode is unchanged.
- Optional: place `taeh3.safetensors` in `ComfyUI/models/vae_approx/` and select it in `tiny_vae` for improved preview colors.

nodes.title: 📖 Prompt Guide
widgets_values:
Continue From Clip - Native AddGuide

Activate the setting "📼 Continue From Clip (NativeAddGuide)" to give MiniMax video and audio context from a previous clip.

Connect the previous video to the Clip input.

Use AddGuide Context Frames to choose how much context MiniMax receives. More frames provide better continuity, but increase generation time.

1 frame: Fastest. Basic visual continuity only like adding last frame as ref. 
 
5 frames: Fast with decent motion continuity.  

22 frames: Recommended, looks like sweet spot good video and audio continuity.  

39 frames: Stronger context, but more slower.

The workflow automatically removes the context frames and audio from the final result. The generated clip contains only new content and keeps the duration selected in MiniMax H3 Director.

nodes.title: 🚀 Quick Start Guide
widgets_values:
## 🚀 Quick Start

### Step 1 — Download Models
Get all required files (See Model Links)

### Step 2 — Set Basic Parameters (Settings panel)

1. **Resolution Preset** — choose a starting point (e.g. 0.83 MP HD)
2. **Aspect Preset** — pick your desired ratio (e.g. 3:4 Photo)
3. **Mode Switch** — toggle FL2VA or REF2VA depending on your needs
4. Leave Sampling defaults (res_multistep / simple / 25 steps) unless you know what you want

### Step 3 — Write Your Prompt (Director node)

Open the **MiniMax H3 Director** node:

1. Pick your mode: **FL2VA** (simple text/image) or **REF2VA** (multi-reference)
2. In the **Global Prompt** editor, write your description using the correct format:
   - FL2VA: `integrated_multimodal_description:` + `overall_soundscape:` + `non_diegetic_music:`
   - REF2VA: full six-section format (see examples below)
3. Adjust **duration** (seconds) to match your scene  
4. You can connect the manual prompt box or any other text node to the external_prompt input to have more control.

### Optional — Add References (REF2VA mode)

- **Add images/videos**: click **+**, drag-and-drop, or paste (Ctrl+V) into the Image/Video lane
- **Add audio**: paste or drop audio files into the Audio lane
- **Trim clips**: drag the crop handles on video/audio tiles (2–15 seconds each)
- **Per-video stream**: use V / A / V+A buttons on video clips
- **Media prompts**: select a tile and write a short note about its role

### Queue!

Click **Queue Prompt** — the Guide node validates everything and routes to the right backend automatically.

---

See the example prompt nodes next to this one for ready-to-use templates.

nodes.title: ⚙️ Settings & Post-Processing
widgets_values:
## Settings Panel Controls

The main Settings subgraph exposes all critical parameters in one panel:

### Resolution & Aspect Ratio
| Setting | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Resolution Preset | Choose precision presets (e.g. 0.83 MP HD) or standard targets like 1080p; actual dimensions adapt to your chosen aspect |
| Aspect Preset | Select aspect ratio (e.g. 3:4 Photo, 16:9 Widescreen); used when no source image is connected |
| Swap Aspect | Flip width/height of the current aspect preset |
| No Scale (Bypass) | Disables all scaling calculations; outputs exact source/manual dimensions |

### Sampling Parameters
| Setting | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Sampler Name | e.g. res_multistep (recommended for MiniMax H3) |
| Scheduler | e.g. simple — controls how noise is removed per step |
| Steps | Number of denoising steps (default 25); more = higher quality but slower |
| Noise Seed | Seed value; randomize or set manually for reproducibility |
| Shift Video | Visual branch shift parameter (default 12) |
| Shift Audio | Audio branch shift parameter (default 3) |

### Model Selection
| Setting | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| UNET (FL2VA) | Select diffusion model for text/image endpoint modes |
| UNET (REF2VA) | Select diffusion model for reference-to-video mode |
| CLIP | Text encoder (Qwen3VL variants supported) |
| Visual VAE | `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors` |
| Audio VAE | `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors` (required for REF2VA) |
| Mode Switch | Toggle between FL2VA and REF2VA operation |

### Upscaling Options
| Option | Behavior |
|--------|----------|
| 🔹 Upscale 2x Simple | Fast Lanczos upscale to exactly 2× resolution; color-corrected, low VRAM usage |
| 🔹 Upscale 2x With Model | Uses selected AI upscaler (e.g. 2x-AnimeSharpV4_RCAN); can enhance/add detail, higher VRAM |
| 🔹 Upscale With RTX Upscaler & Refiner | 4x real-time upscaling using NVIDIA RTX SDK; RTX GPUs only |

### Output Enhancements
| Option | Behavior |
|--------|----------|
| 🗥 Watermark | Overlay custom PNG watermark onto final frames |
| Watermark Path | Select uploaded watermark asset |
| Upload Watermark | Drag-and-drop or browse to load a new watermark image |

### Continue From Clip Continuation
| Option | Behavior |
|--------|----------|
| Continue From Clip | Enables continuation from an approved rendered clip |
| Continue From Clip | Select the approved WEBM/MP4 in the external Load Approved Clip node |
| Context Frames | 22 recommended; video and audio head trimming is automatic |
| Color Match Strength | Automatically active with NativeAddGuide or Masked AV; 0.20 recommended |

### Acceleration Toggles
| Option | Behavior |
|--------|----------|
| 🌈 Spectrum | Enable or bypass Spectrum speculative acceleration from the Settings panel |
| 🔮 SageAttention | Enable when SageAttention is installed; reduces compute time |
| 📚 MemCache | Keep loaded models in memory between runs; speeds up repeated generations; ⚠️ Can introduce loss like ghosting and morphing or other artifacts |

---

## Video Combine Node Settings

The final `DaSiWa EnhancedVideoCombine` node offers:

| Setting | Choices |
|---------|---------|
| Codec | Auto, AV1, VP9, H.264, H.265(HEVC) — hardware-first fallback chain |
| Container | Auto-selected per codec (WebM/MKV/MP4) |
| Bit Depth | Auto (detects 8-bit vs 10-bit source) |
| Quality (CRF/CQ) | Slider; default 20 (lower = better quality, larger file) |
| Ping-Pong | Forward/reverse frame loop |
| Save Metadata | Embed prompt/workflow JSON where format supports it |
| Crop To Audio | Trim video length to match audio duration |
| Audio Codec | Opus, AAC, MP3 (Auto picks best for container) |
| Audio Bitrate | 64–320 kbps |
| Save First/Last Frame | Export individual frames as PNG alongside video |

nodes.title: Remove guide preroll · keep exact Director seconds
CONTINUATION · NATIVE ADDGUIDE + MASKED AV
widgets_values:
**CONTINUATION MODES · EXACT DURATION · NO SAVED OVERLAP**

Enable **📼 Continue From Clip (NativeAddGuide)** to use visual/audio context from the previous clip. Set **↳ AddGuide Context Frames** below it to choose the amount of history. The frame value is ignored while the boolean is off.

**Common AddGuide Context Frames values:**
- **1:** fastest; last-frame-style visual reference with very little motion/audio context.
- **6:** light context; useful for quick tests.
- **12:** balanced short context.
- **22:** recommended starting point for good video and audio continuity.
- **39:** strongest common context; slower and more demanding.

Enable **🔒 Continue From Clip (Masked AV)** only for the exact AV boundary continuation path. Masked AV automatically suppresses NativeAddGuide so both continuation methods are never applied together.

**Automatic color continuity**
When either continuation mode is active, Color Match V2 automatically matches the generated frames to a clean source frame taken 10 frames before the end of the previous clip. Adjust **↳ Color Match Strength** in Settings. **0.20** is recommended; **0.10–0.15** is subtle and **0.25–0.35** is stronger.

widgets_values:
**EXPERIMENTAL · LBH NEURAL LATENT UPSCALE**

Enable **🧬 Latent Upscale (LBH 3D)**, then set **↳ Latent Upscale Scale** below it. The scale value is ignored while the boolean is off.

**Common Latent Upscale Scale values:**
- **1.25×:** subtle enlargement; fastest and lowest extra refinement cost.
- **1.50×:** recommended balanced starting point.
- **1.75×:** stronger enlargement with more high-resolution work.
- **2.00×:** largest common preset; slower, but usually safer for multiple-of-32 alignment.

When active, most sampling steps run at the base resolution, the video latent is enlarged with the LBH 3D BF16 model, and the final 4 steps refine it at high resolution. Audio is separated, kept unchanged, and rejoined automatically.

Required node: **LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler**.
